text:
sara (marketing): Heads-up — marketing planning for next week's Dedicated release. Need final changelog link + docs anchor by EOD today. Also want to slot a webinar and publish a short benchmark narrative. Can we lock rollout timing?
mike_eng: On changelog PR now, will add sample responses and perf numbers. ETA 3pm PT. If marketing needs a 1-paragraph blurb, I can draft.
jia (docs): Docs draft ready for API + examples, pushing updates this afternoon. Temporary link: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated-release (will update to canonical once merged).
tom_ops: Rollout windows: canary 03/30 10:00 PDT, staged ramp 03/31 08:00 PDT, full open 03/31 16:00 PDT. We need marketing embargo until canary is green. Revert window open for 4 hours after canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: canary-2026-03-30T17:00Z by @tom_ops. Status: queued.
sara (marketing): Thanks — please confirm the exact changelog file path for the release notes. Also need a concise benchmark summary (latency/cost) for the blog + webinar deck. Who can draft?
mike_eng: I will draft the benchmarking blurb. Early numbers: ~2.5x throughput on long sequences, ~30% token-cost reduction with smart batching + quant kernels. I'll post the short paragraph in this thread and open a PR to the changelog.
jia (docs): I'll add the canonical docs link + example curl snippet into the changelog once PR lands. Proposed snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"dedicated-v1","prompt":"Summarize..."}'`
ana_sales: Heads up from sales — inbound lead routing: use campaign tag `dedicated_release_march`. We need leads routed to SDR_Enterprise and capture fields for `use_case` + `expected_qps`.
sara (marketing): @ana_sales noted. Marketing ops — can you confirm the mapping and the capture fields? We want to surface expected QPS for handoff to solutions.
ops-bot: Routing rule created: campaign=dedicated_release_march -> queue=SDR_Enterprise; capture_fields=[use_case, expected_qps].
mike_eng: One small blocker: quantization doc still pending. There's a behavioral-change note that must be in the changelog (token truncation in edge case). I'll append it to the PR.
tom_ops: Monitoring dashboard is ready: https://metrics.redwood.ai/dedicated/canary. Alert if p95 latency > 300ms or error-rate > 0.5%.
sara (marketing): Great. Timeline locked: marketing will hold embargo until canary success. I'll assemble assets (blog draft, benchmark summary, webinar slide 1 pager) into the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/release/2026-dedicated. Ping here when final links live so we can publish.
mike_eng: PR for changelog + bench blurb: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/452 (draft).
jia (docs): Docs PR up next, will tag @sara when merged.
tom_ops: If anything blocks canary we revert to previous model variant; will post updates in this thread.
sara (marketing): Thanks everyone — once links are in, I'll schedule the embargoed send and the webinar invite. :thumbsup:
